lines.lyric: Mallabeorin nae du nune barami bureo shiryeo
lines.lyric_hangul: 말라버린 내 두 눈에
lines.lyric_translation: My two dry eyes are cold from the blowing wind

lines.lyric_hangul: 바람이 불어 시려 굳이 애써 참은 눈물이 흘러
lines.lyric_translation: The tears I tried to hold back fall

lines.lyric_hangul: 괜찮을 거라 말해줘
lines.lyric_translation: Tell me it’ll be okay

lines.lyric_hangul: 태양이 뜨는지 지는지는 몰라도 네가 보고 싶어, oh-whoa
lines.lyric_translation: I don’t know whether the sun is rising or setting / I miss you

lines.lyric_hangul: 그 많은 이유 변명 다 소용없단 걸 넌 더 잘 알잖아
lines.lyric_translation: Oh oh, those many reasons and excuses… / …are all useless, you know well

parts.lyric: Oh oh geu maneun iyu byeonmyeong da
Soyongeoptan geol neon deo jal aljana

lines.lyric_hangul: 손을 얹고선 대답해봐, 모르는 척하진 마
lines.lyric_translation: Place your hand and answer / Don’t pretend not to know

lines.lyric_hangul: 돌아갈 길을 나는 잊었어, 이젠 찾을 수도 없어
lines.lyric_translation: I’ve forgotten the path to return / I can’t even find it now

lines.lyric: Ain’t got no better way better way better way
lines.lyric_hangul: Ain't got no better way, better way, better way
lines.lyric_translation: Ain’t got no better way, better way, better way

lines.lyric_hangul: 'Cause I can't handle it, 아무 말도 들리지 않아
lines.lyric_translation: Cause I can’t handle it / I can’t hear any words

lines.lyric_hangul: 여기 있을게, 너 돌아오게 될 거야
lines.lyric_translation: I’ll stay here / You’re going to return

lines.lyric_hangul: Oh, I can't handle it, 더 멀어지지 마 내게서
lines.lyric_translation: Oh, I can’t handle it / Don’t get further away from me

lines.lyric_hangul: Baby, come here quick, we shouldn't call it quits

lines.lyric_hangul: 기억이 스티커처럼
lines.lyric_translation: Like stickers, even if the memories come off

lines.lyric: Tteeo naebeoryeodo jagugi namaseo deo jiteo boyeo
lines.lyric_hangul: 떼어 내버려도, 자국이 남아서, 더 짙어 보여, no
lines.lyric_translation: The mark that is left makes it look thicker

lines.lyric_hangul: 불이 꺼질 수가 없게, yeah
lines.lyric_translation: The fire can’t go out

lines.lyric_hangul: 네 흔적들이 여기저기 남아있잖아, 타들어 가, 타들어 가
lines.lyric_translation: Since traces of you are still left here / It burns down, it burns down

lines.lyric_hangul: 멍이 들어 새파랗게, 가슴을 타고 자꾸 번져만 가
lines.lyric_translation: Bruises form, ashy pale / Climbing my chest, they just keep spreading

lines.lyric_hangul: 커져 버렸어, 내 맘속에 비우는 법도 몰라
lines.lyric_translation: They’ve gotten bigger / I don’t know how to empty my heart

lines.lyric_hangul: 파도가 쓸려 없어졌던 다시 예전 그 자리로
lines.lyric_translation: Back to the spot… / …that got swept away by the waves
